doc.name: A — condiments catalogue, mirror tunnel, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: small-batch miso jar
Category: condiments
Shot programme: mirror tunnel
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director signing off every frame of this condiments campaign. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the dead-on front elevation in a mirror tunnel treatment.

SUBJECT. A small-batch miso jar. Product fidelity is non-negotiable: shape, seams, cap, closure, print placement and colour must match the reference precisely. Only the scene around it is yours to author.

CAMERA. Straight-on front elevation, lens at exact label centre, zero perspective distortion. Shoot on a 35mm reportage at f/4, framing for dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth. Stage the product on or against unglazed stoneware, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
